note: NECO Islamic Studies round 7 (R38 top-up): Malik guarding Hell; the Sirat bridge; the Mizan scale; the People of the Cave; the book of deeds; Yunus and the fish; Nuh's ark; Ibrahim Khalilullah; Sulaiman and the ant; Al-Amin; Abu Talib the protector; the Negus of Abyssinia; Tabuk; Khaybar; Sumayyah the first martyr; Mus'ab the first teacher of Madinah; Hamzah master of martyrs; four rak'ahs of Isha; takbirat al-ihram; the tashahhud; suhur; iftar; niyyah; ushr on crops; tawaf al-wada; the Black Stone. questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: The angel appointed by Allah to guard the gate of Hellfire is
questions.explanation: He keeps the keepers of the fire.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: On the Day of Judgement, every soul must cross the narrow pathway stretched over Hell. It is called
questions.explanation: Only the upright cross it in safety.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: The scale on which the good and bad deeds of mankind will be weighed on the Last Day is the
questions.explanation: Not an atom's weight is lost.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: The young believers who fled persecution and slept for many years in a cave, as the Qur'an relates, are known as
questions.D: the Men of the Cave of Thawr
questions.explanation: Surah al-Kahf opens their story.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.topic: At-Tawhid and the Articles of Faith
questions.q: The record of every person's deeds, kept by the attendant angels, will be given out on the Day of Judgement as
questions.explanation: The two scribes never left his side.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The prophet who was swallowed by a great fish after leaving his people in anger was
questions.explanation: He cried out from the belly of the fish.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The prophet who built a great ark to save the faithful from the flood was
questions.explanation: The animals entered two by two.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The prophet honoured with the title Khalilullah, the Friend of Allah, is
questions.explanation: The friend of Allah broke the idols.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The prophet who understood the speech of the ant and the hoopoe was
questions.explanation: He ruled over men and jinn alike.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Before his call to prophethood, the people of Makkah trusted the young Muhammad (S.A.W.) so deeply that they called him
questions.explanation: Even his rivals left their goods with him.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The uncle who stood by the Prophet (S.A.W.) and shielded him from the Quraysh until his death was
questions.explanation: His protection bought Islam its early years.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The Muslim emigrants who fled to Abyssinia were received and protected by its just king,
questions.explanation: He wept at the recitation of the Qur'an.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The expedition of Tabuk is remembered as the last campaign the Prophet (S.A.W.) led in person, marched against
questions.explanation: The long march to the Syrian border.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The fortress town north of Madinah whose strongholds fell to the Muslims in 7 AH was
questions.explanation: Its fields of palm became the Muslims'.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The first person to be killed for the sake of Islam, a woman steadfast under torture, was
questions.explanation: She died under the spears of Quraysh.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The companion the Prophet sent to Madinah as its first teacher of Islam, before the hijrah, was
questions.explanation: The first envoy of Islam taught the Ansar.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib, martyred at Uhud, is honoured with the title
questions.B: Asadullah reborn, twice lion of Allah
questions.explanation: The lion of Allah fell in the valley.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Four obligatory rak'ahs are observed in which of the five daily prayers?
questions.explanation: The night prayer shares four with Zuhr and Asr.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The prayer is begun by raising the hands and saying Allahu Akbar. This opening takbir is called
questions.explanation: With it the worshipper enters the state of prayer.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The portion of the prayer recited while sitting, in which the worshipper greets the Prophet, is the
questions.explanation: It comes just before the final greeting.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The meal with which a Muslim breaks his fast at sunset is called
questions.explanation: Dates and water hasten the breaking.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Before every act of worship, the firm intention made in the heart is called
questions.explanation: Deeds are judged by the intention behind them.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: Zakat due on farm produce, one-tenth of the harvest from rain-fed land, is called
questions.explanation: A tenth returns to the poor from the field.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The tawaf performed just before a pilgrim finally leaves Makkah is called
questions.explanation: The farewell circuit closes the pilgrimage.

questions.subject: Islamic Studies
questions.q: The black stone set into one corner of the Ka'bah, which pilgrims greet during tawaf, is called
questions.explanation: Pilgrims salute it as they pass.
